message.content: Perfect, thanks. One last thing: explain when I should write a unit test vs an integration test.

content.text: Use a unit test when you want to verify a single function or class in isolation with fast feedback. Use an integration test when you want to verify that several units cooperate correctly across process or service boundaries, especially when the interaction itself is the failure mode. A common rule: unit tests should be cheap and numerous; integration tests should be focused and few, covering the seams between components.
